Game Overview

Chinu Neko 2 is a adventure title where guide a nimble cat through eight perilous levels in Chinu Neko 2. Collect food bowls while dodging rival felines, treacherous spikes, and lethal saws. Master the double-jump to scale obstacles and explore hidden paths. With charming graphics and escalating challenges, this cat quest promises endless fun.
